prashna_chapter4_verse5.title: Prashna Chapter 4 Verse 5
prashna_chapter4_verse5.introduction: This verse belongs to Prashna, Chapter 4.
prashna_chapter4_verse5.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Prashna Upanishad, Chapter 4, Verse 5, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
prashna_chapter4_verse5.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
